messages:
Priya R: looping in CS + eng — Northridge Labs finishes onboarding next week. They see p95 spikes when seq_len > 512 and costs are ~2x on the x-large model. Proposal: try int8 quantized variant for baseline traffic + route long-sequence requests (>)512) to the compact-medium model. want to preempt renewal risk. Thoughts?
Sam W: quick datapoint — ran int8 test on a copy of their workload; ~30% GPU memory + 25% throughput improvement. saw a few degeneracies on code-like prompts though. recommend a small eval set.
Javier C: +1 to int8 canary. operational plan: 1) canary 5% traffic for 48h, 2) enable prefix cache for identical prompts, 3) monitor perplexity + answer-quality evals, 4) auto-fallback to x-large if quality drops >3% on eval set. Also add route rule for seq_len > 512 -> compact-medium.
Marta L: i'll take enablement with the customer — can we share a short playbook and example curl so CS can run a smoke test with them? also need rollback steps for their infra team.
Priya R: yep — sample playbook below (quick snippet). paste into CS convo.
Priya R: ```
# canary route update (example)
POST /v1/routing/policies
{
  "route": "northridge-longseq-compact",
  "match": { "seq_len": ">512" },
  "target": "compact-medium-v2"
}

# deploy quantized model variant (5% canary)
POST /v1/models/deploy
{ "model": "x-large-int8-v1", "traffic_percent": 5 }

# rollback (if regressions)
POST /v1/models/traffic
{ "model": "x-large-v1", "traffic_percent": 100 }
```
Sam W: add eval prompts: short, medium, and code samples. i'll attach the eval set to the ticket. also watch p99 and tokenization failure rate (we saw 0.2% on the test). :mag:
Javier C: operational alerts to set: perplexity regression >3% over baseline, user-reported bad responses >5 in 1h, p99 latency > 2x baseline. if triggered, auto-scale or move canary back to 0%.
Marta L: scheduled enablement call with Northridge for Wed 11am PT. i'll run the smoke test script during the call. CS will capture their acceptance criteria (latency targets + quality spot-check).
ops-bot: canary deploy for x-large-int8-v1 initiated by Javier C at 7065432130 — status: in-progress.
Priya R: thanks! i'll update the renewal playbook and set low-to-medium renewal risk flagged until canary completes. will capture customer feedback during the call.
Sam W: i'll monitor metrics and run the eval harness; posting results in this thread. :thumbsup:
Javier C: i'll keep the fallback ready and standby for rollback.
Marta L: copied into the ticket: CS-1428. i'll post acceptance notes after Wed.
Priya R: perfect — close loop after 48h canary with a short summary (cost delta, p95/p99, eval pass rate).
